Signs of a child who's been rescued too often, the ones loving parents miss: 🛟
🏳️ Quits fast. "I can't do it."
🆘 Needs a fixer. "MOM!"
🚲 Won't try anything new.
👉 Blames others.
🤐 Has no voice. Mom speaks up for him.
🏆 Skips practice.
🧱 Never struggles, so never grows.

Ethan's mom fixed everything. She loved him so much she rescued him 396 times. And every rescue told him the same lie: "You can't." 💔

So she hung up the cape. 🦸‍♀️ Instead of "Let me do it!" she started saying: "I'm here. You try."

Week two? Ethan walked up to his teacher and asked for help, all by himself. ❤️

"Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid… for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest." Joshua 1:9

Jesus rescued us from what we could never fix: our sin. 🙏 But He doesn't carry every step for us. He walks beside us and says, "I'm here."

"I can't" isn't weakness. It's a starting point. Stop rescuing, stand beside them, and watch "I can't" become "I can try." ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
